newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas edges down as production problems solve.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas edges down as production problems solve.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures market saw thin trade on Wednesday afternoon, with front month May edging down slightly after rising in the morning session.
Recent problems at Amoco's Inde 23A compression platform had boosted prompt spot prices over the last two days and this filtered through to the futures market on Wednesday morning.
But Amoco said later that the problems were resolved and it is meeting all its nominations at Bacton in full.
May futures dipped from a high of 10.40 pence to close at 10.35 pence a therm in thin trade in the afternoon session.
Otherwise the only trade seen was a single deal for 25 lots in September at an unchanged price of 10.55 pence a therm, bringing the total day's volume to 120 lots.
